== calls
ls -q
ls --json
exec cpb-rot bash -lc cat ~/.claude-playbook-sandbox 2>/dev/null
secret ls --sandbox cpb-rot
secret set-custom --host api.anthropic.com --env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY --value new-key --placeholder cpb-rot-ANTHROPIC_API_KEY --sandbox cpb-rot
exec -i -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=cpb-rot-ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -e CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<ROOT>/rot cpb-rot bash -lc cd '<WORK>' && exec claude
== stderr
Sandbox cpb-rot reused (--sandbox-fresh recreates it): workdir <WORK>
Secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY stays on the host: injected at the proxy for api.anthropic.com, the sandbox sees a placeholder
